summary.text: With a background in Data Science and hands-on experience in cross-functional operations, I build systems that create clarity, consistency, and forward momentum. My work includes automating reporting workflows that saved 12+ hours of manual work per week, leading a 34-member organization through KPI-based governance, and coordinating large-scale events for more than 1,000 attendees. I bring a structured, data-informed approach to execution, improvement, and team alignment.

details: Designed and implemented automated reporting systems using Excel, reducing manual reporting workload by ~12 hours per week.
Standardized cross-functional SOPs across Finance, Sales, and Operations to improve operational consistency.
Analyzed internal feedback data to generate structured improvement recommendations for management review.
Ensured operational readiness of safety equipment through structured inspection and maintenance systems.
Supported technical training sessions as lead climber and belayer for rescue operations.
Assisted instruction delivery and skill assessment for new trainees.
Led 34-member organization across 10 divisions using structured KPI-based governance.
Designed and executed long-term institutional programs adopted school-wide.
Directed strategic outreach campaigns to 12 feeder schools.
Implemented weekly operational coordination rhythm to maintain cross-divisional alignment.
Coordinated backstage technical execution for events with 1,000+ attendees.
Reduced transition downtime by enforcing structured stage workflows across lighting, sound, and security teams.
Preserved institutional continuity by systemizing archival documentation and accountability reports.
Delivered leadership training programs to 5 junior high schools.

impact.title: Reporting Automation System
impact.desc: Designed and implemented automated reporting systems at Home Digital Indonesia using Excel, eliminating repetitive data entry and formatting. Reduced manual reporting workload by approximately 12 hours per week, freeing capacity for higher-value operational priorities.

impact.title: KPI-Based Governance Leadership
impact.desc: Led a 34-member student council across 10 divisions at SMA Santa Maria 2 through KPI-based governance and weekly coordination rhythms. Designed institutional programs adopted school-wide and directed strategic outreach to 12 feeder schools.

impact.title: Large-Scale Event Execution
impact.desc: Managed program flow as MC at Youth Mass 2025 (GEMA Bandung) for 500+ participants, coordinating speakers, committees, and technical teams. Previously handled backstage operations for 1,000+ attendee events, reducing transition downtime through structured stage workflows.
